units.source_text: 在座诸人略有私语，儒学博士们立刻制止，责备他们无礼。

en.t: When those present began whispering a little among themselves, the Confucian scholars immediately stopped them and reproached them for their rudeness.
They were quick to scold anyone at the slightest provocation.
The sky gradually darkened, and the lamplight glimmered faintly.

units.source_text: 他们的脸在灯光之下，竟像戏剧中的小丑，憔悴而古怪，却又各人不同。

en.t: In the lamplight, their faces looked almost like clowns in a play, haggard and strange, yet each one different from the next.

units.source_text: 他们的样子真是异乎寻常。
源氏内大臣说：“哎呀，不得了！

en.t: Minister Genji said, "Oh dear, this is terrible!

units.source_text: 像我这样顽劣的人，要大受呵斥了！”

en.t: A wayward person like me is sure to be scolded severely!"
Then he slipped behind the curtains and watched from the other side.

units.source_text: 有些大学生来得较迟，座位已满，便想退去。

en.t: Some university students arrived rather late, and when they found all the seats already taken, they thought of leaving.

units.source_text: 源氏知道了，宣召他们到钓殿来，特地犒赏他们种种物品。

en.t: When Genji learned of this, he summoned them to the fishing pavilion and specially rewarded them with various gifts.
